description.value:
Scribing a Spell Scroll by the D&D 2024 rules.

  • You need proficiency in the Arcana skill or with Calligrapher's Supplies.
  • Choose a spell you have prepared (a cantrip or a spell that is always available counts as well). You must have it prepared on each day of the work.
  • No spell slot is used.
  • You must have the spell's Material components at hand. If the spell consumes Material components with a price, that price is a second cost: "Gold (material components)". Others are not part of this recipe.
  • Each day of work is 8 hours; the days needn't be consecutive.
  • Cost and days of work by the spell's level:
LevelDaysCost
Cantrip115 GP
1125 GP
23100 GP
35150 GP
4101,000 GP
5251,500 GP
64010,000 GP
75012,500 GP
86015,000 GP
912050,000 GP

The scroll uses your spell save DC and spell attack bonus.
